description.narrative: Ethiopia, Tuberculosis, Federal Ministry of Health of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia (FMOH)This program has the following goals: Ending TB Epidemic in Ethiopia. To prevent 70,000 - 80,000 new HIV infections by 2020. To save 500,000 - 550,000 lives due to HIV/AIDS by 2020. The objectives of this program are: Improve access to high quality diagnosis and patient centerd treatment by expanding the availability of quality assured microscopy to in all public HFs (Hospitals and HCs), engaging 35,000 health extension workers in tuberculosis control activities, and p. Increase political and community support for TB control through effective advocacy, communication and social mobilization (ACSM), including the revitalization of the Stop TB partnership, and training mass media, and engaging communities in all Zones and 1. Strengthen programme management, monitoring and evaluation by the provision of technical assistance at national and regional level, support for regular TB programme review meetings, biannual integrated and follow-up supervision, and operational research.. To scale up TB/HIV collaborative activities in rural areas by integrating activities in the newly constructed health centres and health posts and home based HIV care so that by 2015 all HIV patients in care are screened for TB and TB patients are routinel

title.narrative: Outcome indicators targets and results for ETH-T-FMOHP03
Case notification rate of all forms of TB per 100,000 population - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse cases

Notification of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases - Percentage of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed, drug resistant RR-TB and/or MDR-TB⃰ as a proportion of the estimated number of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases among notified TB cases
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Treatment success rate of all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse
Impact indicators targets and results for ETH-T-FMOHP03
TB prevalence rate per 100,000 population
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for ETH-T-FMOHP03
Percentage of notified TB cases, all forms, contributed by non-NTP providers - community referrals
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Percentage of new HIV-positive patients starting IPT during the reporting period
Percentage of previously treated TB patients receiving DST (bacteriologically positive cases only)
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Percentage of TB patients who had an HIV test result recorded in the TB register
Percentage of HIV-positive registered TB patients given anti-retroviral therapy during TB treatment

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases
